evidence: Graesse, Orbis Latinus (1861), index s.v. Antwerpen: Antwerpia, Atuatuca
terms.comment: A town takes no preposition: Antverpiam (to), Antverpiae (in, at), Antverpiā (from).

sources: Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio, geographical section, with the authorities it cites (cited as M-O s.v.).
